SetupEncryptionStore remains the mature security authority and hasOtherVerifiedDevices explains the Matrix device/session action without implying a second physical computer. Current public CustomComponentsApi has registerLoginComponent but no post-login-security presentation renderer.
rootCause.requiredRepair: Preserve MatrixChat postLoginSetup, SetupEncryptionStore, InitialCryptoSetupStore, cross-signing, secret storage, recovery, verification requests, reset identity, skip/sign-out and SetupEncryptionBody semantics. Add exactly one narrow additive pinned-Element module presentation seam at the COMPLETE_SECURITY/E2E_SETUP shell boundary. The seam passes already-constructed mature inner security content to a registered renderer and retains Element's current AuthPage/Glass/CompleteSecurityBody rendering as default fallback when no renderer is registered. Register a Yance renderer projecting that mature content inside the existing Yance auth visual hierarchy, with Product-owned explanatory copy for Matrix secure login/session terminology. Do not wrap the whole CompleteSecurity including AuthPage and do not use DOM/CSS guessing to suppress Element lifecycle.
